# Agent Island

> macOS-first local desktop floating island for showing Claude Code and Codex task status. Built with Tauri 2, Vue 3, TypeScript, Vite, Pinia, and Rust services.

Agent Island is a local status layer. It discovers, normalizes, displays, and links back to AI coding agent sessions. It does not take over agent execution, does not upload data, and does not read full conversation content by default.

## Current Implementation Notes

- Frontend is Vue, not React.
- The island collapsed/expanded UI lives in `src/app/IslandApp.vue` and `src/components/island/`.
- Full settings and diagnostics windows are separate from the island and live under `src/app/FullWindowApp.vue` and `src/components/settings/`.
- Tauri invoke/event wrappers live in `src/bridge/tauriApi.ts`.
- Rust adapter and diagnostic types live in `src-tauri/src/adapters/types.rs`.
- macOS full-screen overlay behavior is configured in `src-tauri/src/lib.rs` and `src-tauri/src/services/island_window.rs`.
- Tauri task loading uses config-file discovery as a fallback and does not show mock tasks; browser preview still uses mock tasks.
- Detailed real state ingestion is planned through official hooks and remains source-gated by user settings.

## Safety Constraints

- Do not silently modify user Claude Code or Codex config.
- Hook install must be explicit, previewed, backed up, atomic, and reversible.
- Claude Code and Codex hook integration must be enabled separately by the user; enabling one source must not enable the other, and disabling a source must uninstall Agent Island's own hook command.
- Hook helper must not output stdout/stderr, must not return decision/context fields, and must exit successfully on failure.
- Do not store prompt text, assistant responses, full tool input/output, full shell commands, full patches, or transcript content by default.
